answer: A practical sybil defense uses a time-locked puzzle chain. Each identity extends a forge of sequential work from the prior epoch, forming an unbroken vault of cumulative computation that cannot be parallelized. The voyage of the chain is verified by auditors who replay the computation; any fork or gap invalidates history. An attacker building 500 clones must sustain 500 threads, paying electricity, while an honest agent runs one thread. A forge that diverges is rejected; a cracked vault is discarded; a broken voyage voids chain.
